text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Tokyo Daishoten. The 
Winning Live was so overwhelmingly popular 
that the venue couldn't hold all the 
spectators, leading to screens being set 
up outside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Midway through the concert, the venue's 
lights suddenly cut out—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Played as a surprise on the screen were 
words of gratitude from Symboli Rudolf and 
everyone else who loves Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deeply moving. A tearfully happy finale... 
or so one would think.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Demanding even more cheers, just like a 
true Umadol, Smart Falcon fired up the 
crowd! It was the night a top Umadol was 
born—
